observations: Photo 0 shows a stack of five tires with visible tread wear and dirt, stacked vertically on a dirt ground. A silver alloy wheel is partially visible to the left.
Photo 1 shows the same stack of five tires from a slightly different angle, with the same dirt and wear. The tread pattern is visible, and the sidewall is not clearly readable.

Photo 2 shows four tires lying flat on the ground, with visible tread wear and dirt. The tread pattern is consistent with all tires. A silver alloy wheel is visible in the background. A person's foot in a sandal is visible at the bottom right.
All tires appear to be used, with significant tread wear. No visible damage to the sidewalls or inner carcass is apparent in the photos.
The tires are not mounted on wheels; they are stacked or lying flat. No brand or model markings are visible on the sidewalls in any photo.
The seller claims 'Direct Belgium tyres and wheels', but no evidence in the photos supports this claim.

claims.evidence: No brand or country of origin is visible on the tires in any photo. The claim cannot be verified from the images.
